data.revised_prompt: High-fidelity desktop web app UI mockup for "Glacier Signal", a Chinese A-share evaluation workbench. Scene is a real operating interface for a laboratory quality-control batch release desk, not a poster and not a generic dashboard. 1536x1024 composition, crisp UI typography and dense financial workstation layout. Theme: matte deep-green instrument enamel with bone assay paper surfaces, amber and vermilion status marks, subtle industrial precision details. Main content shows stock "贵州茅台 600519.SH" prominently, with verdict label "等待转强" and score "71/100". Include hard filters panel, technical score section, stop price, position risk, and batch release controls consistent with a quality-control workbench. Use Chinese UI labels and authentic Chinese A-share trading/analysis terms. Layout should feel like a functional enterprise web app with tables, chips, sliders, KPIs, review notes, and status badges. Clean spacing, realistic shadows, sharp contrast, data-rich but legible. No device frame, no watermark, no poster-like hero art, no generic charts-only dashboard.
